title: pilosella stenosoma
intro: Pilosella stenosoma, commonly known as Rock Cinquefoil, is a type of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions. The plant has been found to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella stenosoma include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions and potential health benefits.
